program.section_heading: Building a Canvas Course Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to understand Canvas tools, including Canvas Studio, and how to leverage them to support student learning.

Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to effectively create a Canvas module with a page, a discussion, a quiz, and an assignment as well as to effectively individualize quizzes and assignments for students.
Upon successful completion of the program, students will be able to effectively leverage Design Tools to create visually appealing courses centered around user experience design strategies.

notes: Award is measured in hours: the description calls it an '18-hour certificate' and the block heading reads 'Core Courses-18 hours (Credits listed are in hours)'; total_units recorded as 18 hours.

The catalog prints '0' beside each course and '(Total 0)' for the Core Courses block; these are the noncredit unit values, not hours, so per-course hours are recorded as null and the block's stated total uses the 18 hours from the block heading. Individual course hours are not printed.
Catalog prints codes without a space (ACTCB60AN, ACTCB60BN); these match closed-list ACTC B60AN and ACTC B60BN, so catalog_addition is false.

The description names 'current and future teachers' as the audience the certificate prepares; this was read as the target audience rather than a career outcome, so careers is left empty. A reviewer may wish to check.
Source URL slug references 'summer-2025' while the catalog is labeled 2026-2027; reviewer may confirm catalog year.
